evals.prompt: Migrate this Vite React app from Tailwind CSS 3.4 to Tailwind 4. It has package.json, vite.config.ts, postcss.config.js, src/index.css, and a tailwind.config.js with theme.extend colors.
evals.expected_output: The agent audits first, checks clean git and Node 20+, runs or recommends the official upgrade tool, updates Vite to @tailwindcss/vite, replaces @tailwind directives with @import "tailwindcss", converts custom colors to @theme variables, runs validation commands, and reports remaining visual risks.

evals.prompt: The upgrade tool did not migrate our custom tailwind.config.js. Convert theme.extend colors, fontFamily, screens, boxShadow, and container padding to v4 CSS-first config.
evals.expected_output: The agent uses @theme for color/font/breakpoint/shadow tokens, @utility container for container padding/centering, avoids blindly porting content, flags unsupported safelist/corePlugins/separator if present, and uses @config only as a temporary bridge if required.

evals.prompt: Audit and fix these Tailwind v3 classes for v4: shadow-sm shadow rounded ring outline-none bg-opacity-50 text-opacity-75 hover:!bg-red-500 bg-[--brand] grid-cols-[max-content,auto] transform-none.
evals.expected_output: The agent maps deterministic renames such as shadow-sm→shadow-xs, shadow→shadow-sm, rounded→rounded-sm, ring→ring-3, outline-none→outline-hidden, moves important to the end, changes bg-[--brand] to bg-(--brand), flags opacity utilities for manual color-aware conversion, changes grid comma spaces to underscores, and replaces transform-none with individual reset utilities as appropriate.

evals.prompt: After Tailwind v4, @apply in our Vue single-file components cannot see text-brand-500 or btn utility from app.css. Diagnose and fix.
evals.expected_output: The agent identifies separately bundled stylesheets, adds @reference to the main CSS file in the Vue style block or replaces @apply with CSS variables, confirms custom utilities are defined with @utility where variant-aware behavior is needed, and validates the build.

evals.prompt: Our monorepo package apps/admin uses Tailwind v4 but classes in packages/ui are missing and CMS color classes are generated dynamically.
evals.expected_output: The agent sets source detection correctly with source() or source(none), registers packages/ui with @source, replaces dynamic class concatenation with static maps where possible, uses @source inline() for finite CMS class safelists, and avoids scanning all node_modules.

evals.prompt: The build errors after upgrading: it says Tailwind cannot be used directly as a PostCSS plugin, and our build:css script still calls npx tailwindcss.
evals.expected_output: The agent updates PostCSS to @tailwindcss/postcss, installs/uses @tailwindcss/cli for CLI builds, updates scripts, removes autoprefixer/postcss-import only if not needed elsewhere, and reruns the build.
